name: two coupled spins, field on both spins
question: Does the transverse magnetization of the first spin still rotate when the transverse field acts on both spins?
assumptions: Closed unitary dynamics; hbar = 1; energies and rates in one arbitrary unit.
The model of examples/quantum/two_spins.json with the field on both spins: H = g Z0 Z1 + h (X0 + X1), observable X0.

provenance.origin: authored control for the closure of the observable (tutorial Chapter 24, Section 6)
